question: review-0637 GH-b: ot_hdc_fp4qdq (shipped DS FP4 E4M3-scale quantiser) does not saturate the E4M3 scale at 448; the golden (hdc_golden_v41.qdq_fp4_e4m3) does (SATFINITE). Is the core on the DS token path, and can real DS blocks reach the divergence point?

core.behaviour: s = E4M3-grid RNE of amax/6 with no upper clamp (header line 10)

divergence_point.first_block_amax: amax/6 > 464 (midpoint 448|480, the tie rounds to 448): amax > 2,784 (2,688 = 6*448 is where the golden scale reaches 448; RTL and golden still agree until the rounding moves past 448)

on_token_path.where: DS compressor: ckv = qdq_fp4_e4m3(rope_tail(lat), 16) at the 4 KV-source layers (2, 8, 14, 20), every token whose position closes a compression group; the only FP4-E4M3 quantise point in DS-V4.1 (index keys / queries use the UE8M0 quantiser; weights are pre-quantised)
on_token_path.consumers: ot_hdc_v41_qe (DS quant engine), dshbm_1m_local composition, HGI FUSED.QDQ_FP4_E4M3

analytic.rule: lat = RMSNorm(pooled) * g (n = 512): |lat_i| <= sqrt(512) * |g_i|; the RoPE tail rotates pairs (pair norm preserved), so every element of the quantiser input is <= sqrt(512) * max|g| (x1.004 BF16 rounding margin)

measured.source: 1M reference token shards on ot-epyc1tb (/srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/hbm-sim/ref, ctx 1,048,576 seed 20260930): ckv rows of the 4 KV-source layers

verdict: UNREACHABLE on DS-V4.1: the input bound (25.4 analytic, 2.81 measured) is ~110x below the divergence point; DS is exact today and the shared core needs no change for DS. The missing clamp matters only for the generic FUSED.QDQ_FP4_E4M3 on other models: CF-QDQ carries a saturating-block vector (amax 2,784 tie, 2,785, 3,000, 1e30) that a conforming core must match, i.e. the SATFINITE opt-in (codex/hgi-quant-decode) must be on for non-DS programs.
